items.exampleEn: The leader used club money for his own meals, which was a clear abuse of power.
items.exampleZh: 社長拿社團的錢買自己的餐點，明顯是濫用職權。

items.exampleEn: The museum shows the presidential cars of many different countries.
items.exampleZh: 博物館展示了許多不同國家的總統座車。

items.exampleEn: In many courts, a jury is made up of twelve ordinary people.
items.exampleZh: 在許多法院裡，陪審團由十二位一般民眾組成。

items.exampleEn: The school is investigating complaints about the food in the cafeteria.
items.exampleZh: 學校正在調查有關學生餐廳伙食的投訴。

items.exampleEn: Before the race, she followed a strict training regime every morning.
items.exampleZh: 比賽前，她每天早上都遵守嚴格的訓練計畫。

items.exampleEn: Teachers should think about students' welfare, not just their test scores.
items.exampleZh: 老師應該關心學生的福祉，而不是光看考試成績。

items.exampleEn: Every country has legislation about food safety.
items.exampleZh: 每個國家都有關於食品安全的法規。

items.exampleEn: A coalition of small shop owners asked the mall to lower its rent.
items.exampleZh: 一群小店店主組成聯盟，要求購物中心調降租金。

items.sentenceEn: The film festival jury watched more than fifty movies in a week.
items.sentenceZh: 影展評審團一週內看了五十多部電影。

items.audioEn: Our company has improved staff welfare by adding a gym and a free lunch on Fridays.
items.audioZh: 我們公司增設了健身房和星期五免費午餐，改善員工福利。
items.questionZh: 公司怎麼改善員工福利？
options: A gym and free Friday lunches

items.sentenceEn: The new manager introduced a strict regime of weekly reports.
items.sentenceZh: 新經理推行了每週交報告的嚴格制度。

items.sentenceEn: Our student club held its first presidential election last week.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的學生社團上週舉行了第一次會長選舉。

items.stemEn: Ten environmental groups formed a ____ to protect the coastline.
items.stemZh: 十個環保團體組成聯盟，一起保護海岸線。

items.stemEn: The new ____ means that all new buildings must have solar panels.
items.stemZh: 新法規意味著所有新建築都必須裝設太陽能板。

items.passageEn: Last month, our city's animal shelter was in the news. A group of volunteers formed a coalition with local vets and an ecologist to improve the welfare of homeless dogs and cats. They started a campaign to teach people how to report animal abuse. A news team investigated the shelter and found that it needed more space and staff. Soon after, the city council discussed new legislation to give shelters more money. Meanwhile, a famous singer gave a charity concert, and all the money went to the shelter.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們市的動物收容所上了新聞。一群志工和當地獸醫及一位生態學家組成聯盟，改善流浪貓狗的福祉。他們發起一項宣導活動，教大家如何通報虐待動物的事件。一個新聞團隊調查了收容所，發現那裡需要更多空間和人手。不久之後，市議會討論新的法規，要撥更多經費給收容所。同時，一位知名歌手舉辦了一場慈善演唱會，所有收入都捐給了收容所。

questions.questionZh: 新聞團隊調查後發現了什麼？
options: 志工們都沒受過專業訓練
動物們都被照顧得非常好
收容所下個月就要關閉了

questions.questionZh: 演唱會的收入捐給了哪裡？

items.promptZh: 評審團花了三個小時才選出得獎作品。
referenceEn: The jury took three hours to choose the winning work.
It took the jury three hours to pick the winner.
rubricZh: jury 指評審團（例如 the jury）

items.instructionZh: 用 investigate 造一個句子，說說你曾經想調查清楚的一件事（輕鬆的話題即可）。
referenceEn: I investigated why my plants kept dying, and I found I was giving them too much water.
I want to investigate where the strange noise in my apartment comes from.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："上個月，我們市的動物收容所上了新聞。一群志工和當地獸醫及一位生態學家組成聯盟，改善流浪貓狗的福祉。他們發起一項宣導活動，教大家如何通報虐待動物的事件。一個新聞團隊調查了收容所，發現那裡需要更多空間和人手。不久之後，市議會討論新的法規，要撥更多經費給收容所。同時，一位知名歌手舉辦了一場免費演唱會，所有收入都捐給了收容所。"；改後："上個月，我們市的動物收容所上了新聞。一群志工和當地獸醫及一位生態學家組成聯盟，改善流浪貓狗的福祉。他們發起一項宣導活動，教大家如何通報虐待動物的事件。一個新聞團隊調查了收容所，發現那裡需要更多空間和人手。不久之後，市議會討論新的法規，要撥更多經費給收容所。同時，一位知名歌手舉辦了一場慈善演唱會，所有收入都捐給了收容所。"

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：邏輯不通："gave a free concert, and all the money went to the shelter"——免費演唱會沒有門票收入，「所有收入」從何而來交代不清；建議改 charity concert 或 "asked fans for donations"。passageZh 同步修。
